source_title: Auqib Nabi set to replace Prasidh Krishna for India vs New Zealand ODIs. - Sportstar
source_excerpt:
File Photo: Aquib Nabi has impressed selectors in recent India A outings and is set to return to the ODI squad. | Photo Credit: Imran Nissar
India’s fast bowler, Prasidh Krishna, has not recovered from his hamstring injury in time to be a part of the ODI series against New Zealand starting on November 4.
Auqib Nabi, who impressed in the recent unofficial red ball game between India A and New Zealand A, has been called up as Prasidh’s replacement.
Reports state that although Prasidh has stepped up his training, it is believed that he is not yet in Test match fitness, where he is more key for India.
He hurt his hamstring during the ODI series against the West Indies.
